method: Create a fresh simulation project, discover the packaged IP in IP Catalog, instantiate the catalog IP as dut_ip, generate outputs, and simulate that instance.
assertion_count_note: Includes repeated protocol stability checks; not the count of independent functional scenarios.
checks: LED reset, full-word write, pin output and register readback
Independent AW and W arrival order
B and R response stability under backpressure
Native vendor AXI GPIO ignores WSTRB; software uses full 32-bit MMIO writes
Five-bit button input readback and zero upper bits
Interrupt status captures changes with enables disabled
Global and channel interrupt enables independently gate IRQ
Interrupt status Toggle-On-Write behavior and safe read-then-clear
Press and release both raise level IRQ
Stable held button does not generate another change event
Reset clears enables, status and LEDs, then AXI remains operational
scope: Functional simulation of the new packaged GPIO IP only. No physical board test was performed on this revision.
